name: claude-delivery-plugin
description: Single-plugin marketplace for the delivery pipeline plugin. This repository is both the plugin and the marketplace that serves it, so `claude plugin marketplace add openzigs/claude-delivery-plugin` is all a consumer needs.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: A project-agnostic delivery pipeline: workflows that take a GitHub issue through implement, independent review, fix and re-review, and that turn a topic into a filed epic with sub-issues. Seven agents, eight skills, no hardcoded project rules.
